items.content:
Dear Pathfinders,

All Aniimo servers are now live! Thank you for your patience and understanding during the service maintenance.

As compensation, we will provide the following:

Service Maintenance Compensation

  • 500 Glimmers — original maintenance compensation

    [/*]

  • 500 Glimmers — additional compensation for the delayed launch

    [/*]

Known Issue Compensation

  • 1 Sparkling Cube

    [/*]

Please note that the in-game mailbox is currently unavailable, so the compensation will be sent in two separate in-game mails once the mailbox function is restored:

  • Mail 1: 1,000 Glimmers — Service Maintenance Compensation

    [/*]

  • Mail 2: 1 Sparkling Cube — Known Issue Compensation

    [/*]

We appreciate your patience while we work to resolve this issue. Thank you for your continued support and understanding!

Dear Pathfinders,

When the wind rises, it beckons a new Departure. Your journey across the continent of Idyll starts here and now.

Polaris Institute is scheduled to undergo server maintenance for an update from September 23, 2026, 00:00 to 10:00 UTC. Following this update, the game will officially launch globally on mobile platforms. Servers will be offline during this period, so please plan your adventures accordingly.

Here is a summary of the incoming updates for your reference:

>Maintenance Schedule

\

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/09/22 16:00 - 2026/09/23 02:00 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/09/22 12:00 - 22:00 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」2026/09/23 00:00 - 10:00 UTC+8

\: Glimmer x500

\: All Pathfinders registered prior to the version 1.1 update.

* Actual maintenance duration may vary based on progress. We appreciate your patience and understanding. Once maintenance is complete, please restart your game client to ensure you're on the latest build.

>New Content Preview

Legendary Journey: Windchaser's Departure—New Stage Unlocked

Legendary Aniimo ""Irisalis"" Debuts

Legend has it that Irisalis blooms amidst radiant colors, gathering the world's hues to breathe life and vigor into the land. Pathfinder, follow the drifting petals on the breeze and seek out its presence.

\

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/09/25 10:00 - 2026/12/09 23:59 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/09/25 10:00 - 2026/12/09 19:59 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」2026/09/25 10:00 - 2026/12/10 07:59 UTC+8

\

Level reaches Student I.

\

Legendary Journey: Windchaser's Departure—Iris Companion

A new weekly-limited source for Iris Petals has been introduced. Spend a required number of Iris Petals to craft the Legendary Aniipod: Irisalis.

Once successfully crafted, the cube unlocks the Rift Space where Irisalis resides. Forge your Twine to unlock the Blessing Gifts.

After befriending Irisalis, you will also unlock its exclusive Transmog ability.

Legendary Journey: Windchaser's Departure—Blessing Gifts

During the Windchaser's Departure season, after crafting the Legendary Aniipod: Irisalis, you can spend a certain number of Iris Petals to craft the Legendary Aniipod: Windchaser's Departure.

Using the Legendary Aniipod: Windchaser's Departure guarantees a 100% capture rate. The captured Aniimo is guaranteed to possess the Perfect Innate Potential, appear in its Sparkling Form, and carry exclusive seasonal perks for Windchaser's Departure.

Gameplay Updates

Holo-Battle Interlink

\

Every week from Thursday 04:00 to Monday 03:59 post-update.

\

Character reaches Trailblazer I.

\

Developed by the Battle Art, Holo-Battle Interlink uses advanced simulation technology to recreate Alpha encounters based on historical data of high-threat Aniimos. Form a 4-player team or match with AI teammates to take on the challenge.

In each cycle, you can challenge three distinct routes, each featuring unique Alphas and environmental mechanics. Customize your Aniimo lineup and select buff effects prior to battle (selected by the Team Leader in 4-player co-op).

All routes can be replayed freely. The system tracks your highest Star Rank for each route independently, unlocking milestone rewards based on your combined Star total across all three routes. Assisting fellow Pathfinders in improving their Star Ranks also grants Support Rewards. Both Star Rank Rewards and Support Rewards reset weekly.

Operation: Egg Heist Team Mode—Chaos Mode

\

「Aniimo-Europe」Unlocks on 2026/09/24 04:00 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」Unlocks on 2026/09/24 04:00 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」Unlocks on 2026/09/24 04:00 UTC+8

\

Reach Tier IV "Elite Egg Seeker" in Operation: Egg Heist.

\

This is the pinnacle difficulty mode, requiring a Chaos Ticket for entry. It features significantly higher drop rates for Prismana Aniimo Eggs and Prismatic Collectibles, alongside opportunities to discover ultra-rare Secret Collectibles. However, Chaos Mode is fraught with peril and enforces strict escape conditions. Teaming up is highly recommended.

New Events Available

Glamour Star

\

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/09/25 04:00 - 2026/10/02 03:59 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/09/25 04:00 - 2026/10/02 03:59 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」2026/09/25 04:00 - 2026/10/02 03:59 UTC+8

\

Character reaches Student II.

\

Audition Theme: Floral Soirée.

Select a suitable Aniimo and accessorize it to fit the theme before submitting your entry. The Institute will score your Aniimo based on how well the Aniimo and its accessories match the current theme. Reach specific score milestones to claim corresponding rewards.

Aniimo Discovery

\

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/09/25 04:00 - 2026/10/09 03:59 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/09/25 04:00 - 2026/10/09 03:59 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」2026/09/25 04:00 - 2026/10/09 03:59 UTC+8

Polaris Institute has sighted a brand-new Aniimo across Idyll and needs your help conducting field research.

Spend Search Attempts to track and capture it across the continent. Free Search Attempts will be replenished periodically by the Institute. Note that unspent free attempts do not stack, so be sure to use them promptly.

If you run out of free attempts, you can spend Vein Essence to continue searching.

Complete research quests tied to this Aniimo to earn rich rewards. As your research progress advances, you'll also unlock various Search Buffs at the Research Center.

Vein Abundance

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/09/28 04:00 - 2026/10/05 03:59 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/09/28 04:00 - 2026/10/05 03:59 UTC-4

Drawn by surges in Vein energy, special Prismana Form Aniimos will spawn in designated regions for a limited time. The schedules and locations are as follows:

Journey Chronicles

\

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/10/01 04:00 - 2026/10/29 03:59 UTC-4

\

Every encounter along the way is a memory worth treasuring. Log in for a specified number of days during the event to claim travel gifts and capture unforgettable moments with your Aniimos!

New Appearance

Appearance Set: Radiant Waveglow

Sway with the tides and glow with radiant brilliance.

Head over to Shop - Featured to purchase the new Radiant Waveglow set for 980 Lumin Crystals.

Accessory & Furniture Pack: Laurel Moon Blessing

When the moon climbs the branches, sweet laurel scents fill the air—a gentle gift from a moonlit night.

Head over to Shop - Featured to purchase the pack for 280 Lumin Crystals, which includes: Furniture ""Floral Moon Jukebox"" x1, Accessory ""Laurel Lantern"" x1, and Accessory ""Moonbound Journey"" x1.

>Quality-of-Life Optimizations

Story Experience

1. Added a new option "Pathfinder Voice" in Settings - Sound Settings - Volume Balance, used to control the playback settings for Pathfinder voice in game story.

2. The quest series name for Title Promotion Assessment has been uniformly changed to Promotion Series, making it easier for Pathfinders to identify and search.

3. Adjusted the quest objective descriptions for a small number of Elite Training Plan quests to make them clearer and more aligned with actual requirements.

Home System

1. Added direct shortcuts to the Home Shop and Co-op Store within the General Service Area section of Home Management.

2. Added an E-Mode toggle switch in Facility Management under the Production Area section of Home Management.

3. Improved the visual indicator display for Snap Points when using Build Snapping.

4. Enhanced controller navigation across several interfaces, including Home Layouts, Home Index, Park Buffs, Home Season Lunar Crops, and Building Controls.

5. Upgraded art assets for select furniture pieces, fixing collision, model height, and texture alignment issues.

6. Added a new level-up reward "Mysterious Prismana Egg" at "Home" levels 15 and 18.

System & Features

1. Temporarily hidden unobtained Sparkling Forms in Aniilog. A future update will re-enable previewing unobtained Sparkling Forms.

2. Added access to the Branch interface directly from Outpost.

3. Improved resource cost displays on the Appearance Design interface.

4. Refined warning prompts for conflicting outfit pieces.

5. Equipping specific outfit sets now activates Affinity Abilities between your character and designated Aniimos.

6. Streamlined the Companion Mode, allowing you to invite friends on a Companion without needing to stand face-to-face in-game.

7. Standardized the interaction entry points for initiating and ending Companions.

8. Improved gathering mechanics during Companions: when any player gathers a rare resource, it is now shared with all party members in the Companion state.

9. Polished character poses and animations for Friendship Tree Affinity photos.

10. Upgraded Voice-to-Text translation: detecting foreign speech now automatically transcribes and translates it into your language.

11. Enhanced interactive messaging: tapping a Pathfinder's avatar now directly opens their interaction panel.

12. Extended the bloom duration of Blooms from 2 minutes to 3 minutes.

13. Increased the single-purchase quantity limit in the Shop from 99 to 100.

Performance & Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue causing screen discoloration (red tinting) on certain devices.

2. Fixed localized rendering blackouts occurring on specific GPU models.

3. Resolved an issue where the client could enter an infinite reconnection loop under certain circumstances.

4. Optimized rendering performance for target-locking indicators and floating damage numbers.

5. Reduced UI-related stuttering for a smoother navigation experience.

6. Optimized memory management and performance overhead for select environmental assets.

7. Slightly increased the animation frame rate on PC.

Console/Controller-Specific Experience Optimization

1. Optimized combo key operations to prevent accidentally opening the emote bar during combat.

2. Added an operation tip "Long-press Y to open the radial menu" to the Settings system.

3. Adjusted some buttons in the event interface to trigger on long press.

4. Adjusted the "Nurture" button to trigger on tap.

5. Adjusted the help system pop-up to be entered by long-pressing the Option button.

6. Optimized the alignment display of quest bar icons and button prompts.

7. Fixed an issue where players could not navigate to the skin selection option when using a controller.

8. Fixed an issue where gradient colors could not be selected in the appearance interface.

9. Fixed an issue where the soft keyboard could not be brought up when entering a face customization code.

10. Fixed an issue where the soft keyboard could not be brought up when naming the "RV", and the name could not be changed when first seeing the Home RV.

11. Fixed an issue where the game incorrectly prompted that the controller was disconnected and the prompt window could not be closed.

12. Fixed an audio abnormality after returning to the game using Quick Resume.

13. Fixed an issue where Aniimo custom videos did not play on PS5.

14. Fixed an issue on Xbox where the game froze when opening the chat interface and sending text messages.

Other Experience Optimizations

1. The "Inherit" button is prominently displayed in the info interface for Pathfinders' convenience.

2. Optimized the icons and descriptions of Elite Training Plan Bonded Held Items.

3. Optimized the feedback prompt when Pathfinders' "Windborn Stamp" and "Voxel Coin" reach the acquisition cap.

>Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue where the core effect of the held item "Echoing Grimoire" triggered abnormally, so that the actual effect is consistent with the description.

2. Fixed an issue where the "Helion" model rarely disappeared in story cutscenes.

3. Fixed an issue in the journey quest "A Fragrant Dream" where two interactions were required to complete the quest.

4. Fixed an issue in "Pathfinder Challenge" where damage loss occasionally occurred after knocking enemies airborne.

5. Fixed an issue in "Pathfinder Challenge" where players were occasionally knocked outside the invisible wall.

6. Fixed an issue in "Pathfinder Challenge" where the invisible wall occasionally did not disappear.

7. Fixed an issue in "Pathfinder Challenge" where some Aniimo owners' names were incorrect.

8. Fixed an issue with abnormal model display for "Helmut".

9. Fixed an issue with abnormal model display for "Flamerion" after being revived from the fainted state.

10. Fixed an issue where, after "Blazen" entered the Overcharged state, switching to another Aniimo to release skills could not restore Ultimate Points.

11. Fixed an issue where players occasionally got stuck inside walls when entering and exiting climbing.

12. Fixed an issue in "Twine Mode" where sprinting on the beach did not leave footprints.

13. Fixed an issue where abnormal actions occurred after opening the "Menu" while the character was in the fainted state.

14. Fixed an issue in the "Sanctum" where restarting the client during the black screen of character fainting caused the character to get stuck.

15. Fixed an issue where screen flickering could occur when skipping story.

16. Fixed an issue where level 10 orders were incorrectly generated at "Home" level 9; order levels now correctly match "Home" level.

items.content:
Dear Pathfinders,

To provide a better experience, Polaris Institute will continue to improve the game and address any issues identified. The fixes included in this update are as follows:

>>Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue where the active Aniimo had a small chance of failing to Revive properly after fainted multiple times in a Sanctum. If Pathfinders still encounter this issue, exiting and re-entering the current scene can fix.

2. Fixed an issue where Catch results could not be processed correctly.

3. Fixed an issue where the hatching conditions for "Bond Eggs" did not match their descriptions.

4. Fixed an issue where Pathfinder using non-ATK Skills would trigger Aniimo ATK.

5. Fixed an issue where Bloom in "Zephyrus Landbridge" were linked to the wrong Aniimo Family.

6. Fixed an issue where Shrubclaw could disappear during the cave activity in Argent Strait.

7. Fixed an issue where NPCs could disappear during interaction, preventing Pathfinders from proceeding.

8. Fixed an issue where Pathfinder voice lines could overlap.

9. Fixed an issue where "Daily Activity" mail rewards were displayed incorrectly when resent.

10. Fixed an issue where Accessory adjustments were not saved after swapping slots.

11. Fixed an issue where designated Aniimo were not refreshed after using Nurture Offerings to Nurture Veins in certain Areas.

12. Fixed an issue where hair could appear stretched during initial character customization.

>>Optimizations & Adjustments

1. Optimized the icons and descriptions of Held Items in "Elite Training".

2. Optimized the display of "Mark Sharing". When "Mark Sharing" is near other interactable targets, its entry will be automatically hidden from the interaction List. To interact with "Mark Sharing", move away from other interactable targets.

3. Adjusted rules displayed on "Aniimo Exchange".

8. Fixed an issue where Companion Handbook EXP was not displayed properly on the Monthly Pass make-up check-in reward screen.

items.title: Free-to-play Creature Collector RPG Aniimo launches on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox
items.summary: Pawprint Studio has released creature collecting RPG, Aniimo, on PC (Steam, Epic), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S.
items.content:
After months of beta testing, Pawprint Studio has released creature collecting RPG, Aniimo , on PC (Steam, Epic), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S. It’s also coming to mobile platforms on September 23.

Xbox Game Pass subscribers also receive an exclusive monthly Aniimo pack, which includes 1 Aniipod Ultra, 15 Growth Flowers, and 300 Glimmer.

Aniimo is a colorful world filled with creatures, inspired by Genshin Impact and Pokémon. As new Pathfinders, it’s the player’s job to explore the world of Idyll and discover the titular Aniimo.

At launch, the game includes over 200 Aniimo, including regional and color variants, and multiple rarities.

The open world features multiple territories supporting different levels of play, from quests to bosses and hidden treasures, and more.

In addition to summoning different Aniimo in real-time battle, players can also merge with their Aniimo directly. The process is called Twining, and it’s what sets Aniimo apart from most creature battlers. Through Twining, players become their favorite Aniimo, battling in third-person action. Each Aniimo has unique abilities and traits, and many can help travel around the world by gliding, climbing, or swimming.

Pathfinders also gain access to their own personal Homeland area, where they can build, expand, and customize an automated farm, and provide a home to their Aniimo.

I quite enjoyed the game when I played the Aniimo beta earlier this year.

Although primarily designed as an online single-player game (like many Hoyoverse gacha games ), Aniimo supports cooperative play to join with friends, or engage in specific PvP modes.

“The Aniimo team has worked diligently to finally bring the dreams of ourselves and our players to reality,” said Janson Zhang, Lead Game Designer, Pawprint Studio. “Through their efforts and immense support from Pathfinders around the globe, the world of Aniimo is now ready for you to discover with us, and we can’t wait to go on this journey together!”

New players can unlock the following free in-game launch rewards:

Aniimo is free-to-play on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox. It releases on September 23 on iOS and Android mobile platforms. A Mac version is also coming soon. It’s rated E10+.

items.title: Cute Critters Come to the Cloud: ‘Aniimo’ Launches on GeForce NOW
items.summary: Explore the creature-catching adventure at launch, alongside ‘Active Matter,’ ‘Outer Wilds’ and '007 First Light' with a path-tracing update.
items.content:
A new creature-catching adventure is ready to stream from the cloud this week. Pawprint Studio’s Aniimo arrives on GeForce NOW at launch, inviting gamers to explore the vibrant continent of Idyll across supported devices.

Also this week, 007 First Light receives a path-tracing update on GeForce NOW, alongside a smashing limited-time Deluxe Edition sale on Steam and Epic Games Store .

Gaijin Network’s fractured-multiverse action game Active Matter and Annapurna Interactive’s acclaimed space mystery Outer Wilds are also among 11 new titles joining the cloud this week.

The path to Idyll begins now. Aniimo is a free-to-play, open-world creature-catching role-playing game where every creature encountered can become a companion. Catch Aniimo with Aniipods, then Twine with them to take on their form and use unique skills to solve puzzles, win battles and overcome challenges.

Glide, dive and burrow across Idyll, then return to a personal RV to build a warm, interactive Homeland alongside Aniimo companions. Stream Aniimo on a Steam Deck , in the newly supported Firefox browser and across any other supported devices — without waiting through its 45GB download or making room in local storage. There’s always room in the Homeland for one more Aniimo.

In the critically acclaimed, multimillion-selling 007 First Light , follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6’s training program, and discover a reimagined origin story of the world’s most famous spy. Incorporating IO Interactive’s signature stealth gameplay with world-class Bond action, players can embark on missions in breathtaking locations around the globe, drive iconic vehicles and dive into a cinematic adventure in pursuit of a rogue agent who’s always one step ahead.

Path tracing has now been added to 007 First Light , introducing extra-detailed lighting, shadows and reflections, making its levels and set pieces even more cinematic, immersive and realistic. And NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction ensures the fidelity, clarity and accuracy of these additions are at their absolute best.

Ultimate members can stream with GeForce RTX 5080-class performance, with up to 5K high dynamic range and cinematic-quality streaming. DLSS 4.5 Super Resolution and Dynamic Frame Generation accelerate frame rates and enhance image quality.

A limited-time opportunity awaits: the 007 First Light Deluxe Edition is on sale on Steam from Sept. 15-29 and on Epic Games Store from Sept. 3-18. The mission is on sale. The getaway car is in the cloud.

Gaijin’s Active Matter , a realistic military shooter set in a fractured multiverse, has launched on GeForce NOW. As an operative stuck in a time loop, join dangerous raids for loot or intense player vs. player battles.

Fight against rivals from other timelines, survive physics-breaking anomalies and try to stay alive. Harvest active matter, gather loot and extract to a safe place before the whole zone ceases to exist.

Ultimate members can take on each raid with GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud, delivering high frame rates, advanced graphics features and low latency across supported devices. The zone won’t wait — and neither does the next loop.

Outer Wilds joins the GeForce NOW library this week. As the newest recruit of Outer Wilds Ventures, search for answers across a strange, ever-changing solar system trapped in an endless time loop. Gamers can trace mysterious signals, decipher alien writing and discover hidden locations before an underground city is swallowed by sand or a planet crumbles beneath their feet.

Dates listed above reflect when games are released on their respective stores. GeForce NOW availability may vary, as games are onboarded after they’re released and added throughout the week. Keep an eye on GeForce NOW channels and GFN Thursdays for availability updates to announced titles.

items.content:
Dear Pathfinders,

Here is a summary of the currently known game issues. The Polaris Institute is actively working to resolve them. Please take note of the following:

1. Sealed Eggs from the Closed Beta claimed through the Bonded Promise Event have an issue with their Innate Potential data. The related claim entry has been temporarily closed and will reopen once the issue is fixed.

2. Some visual effects may display abnormally when entering Astra for the first time.

>> Additional Information

If a black screen occurs, please try the following:

1. Update the graphics driver

2. Try switching between DX11 and DX12.

3. Disable DLSS and Frame Generation on the login screen.

Steam controller not working

Please go to your Aniimo game page in your Steam Library → Manage → Properties → Controller, and switch it to "Disable Steam Input," then restart the game.

To provide a better experience, Polaris Institute will continue to improve the game and address any issues identified. The fixes included in this update are as follows:

>>Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue where some Pathfinders may experience abnormal damage values during combat.

2. Fixed an issue where the interface may have displayed abnormally when entering Home.

3. Fixed an issue where some Pathfinders may have experienced repeated disconnections and reconnections during client lag.

4. Fixed an issue where "Prismatic Kite Flowers" were not properly counted under certain conditions.

5. Fixed an issue where incorrect prompt messages were shown when the "Home" season feature had not reached the required level to unlock.

6. Fixed a black screen issue when returning to "Design Workshop" from the Shop interface.

7. Fixed an issue where the like-related buttons disappeared on the photo interface.

8. Fixed occasional Abnormal Status operations during the "Aniimo Management" tutorial.

9. Fixed an issue where certain items purchased on Xbox and Xbox PC were not delivered properly.

items.title: New Pokémon Competitor Launches With Over 100,000 Players on Steam
items.summary: Aniimo has launched with over 100,000 concurrent players on Steam, but the new Pokémon-like RPG is already receiving mixed reviews.
items.content:
Aniimo has launched with over 100,000 concurrent players on Steam, but the new Pokémon-like RPG is already receiving mixed reviews.

X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard .chargbee-tabs .tab-button .discount{ display:none; } .chargbee-tabs .tab-button .discount .discount-tag{ line-height: 24px !important; } .chargbee-tabs .tab-button.most-popular .join-now-button:hover { background: #000 !important; color: #fff !important; outline: 1px solid #fff !important; } .chargbee-tabs .tab-button .join-now-button:hover { background: 0 0; outline: 1px solid rgba(12, 12, 12, 1); color: rgba(12, 12, 12, 1); } @media (max-width: 1220px){ .chargbee-tabs .tab-button .join-now-button { width: 100% !important; position: unset !important; } } A new creature-catching game called Aniimo has just been released, and the Pokémon-like RPG has already surpassed 100,000 concurrent players on Steam. Could this be the next Palworld to offer players an alternative to Pokémon?

Aniimo is a new open-world creature-catching RPG from Chinese developer Pawprint Studio. In the game, you explore a vast world and throw cubes at wild Aniimo to catch them before using the creatures in battle. Sounds a lot like Pokémon , right?

However, Aniimo puts its own spin on the familiar formula by allowing players to transform into their creatures. You can then directly control them to explore the world, complete traversal sections and solve puzzles.

Like Palworld , Aniimo appears to offer a fresh take on the catch ’em all genre. Despite only launching today, September 16, the game is already a hit on PC. According to SteamDB , Aniimo has surpassed 101,717 peak concurrent players on Steam . Considering it is still early morning across much of North America, that is pretty impressive!

It is difficult to say whether this will be the next Palworld , but Aniimo has already impressed Pokémon fans with its gorgeous visuals. However, despite its promising player count, not everyone is enjoying the new creature-catching RPG.

At the time of writing, Aniimo has a “Mixed” user rating on Steam. One of the biggest complaints is that the game reportedly adopts a gacha-like structure after its opening tutorial, with microtransactions and paid options that can speed up progression.

“Has such potential. Very good graphics, cool design of aniimo. However about an hour into the game you are bombarded with monthly passes, stores, objectives that you can bypass by paying, ways to speed up your levelling. Its very much a gatcha game,” one Steam user review reads. Another frustrated reviewer wrote: “Aniimo promised an authentic, gacha-free creature collector, but it delivers nothing more than a glorified digital storefront.”

It should be pointed out that the game does not require players to purchase these items. Not every review has been negative, either. One player wrote: “Im already loving how cute the aniimo and everything about this game is. It’s basically Palworld + Infinity Nikki! ”

While its Steam reviews are currently mixed, Aniimo is already off to a strong start based on how many people are playing it. Even if it does not reach the ridiculous heights of Palworld , this is another example of how much demand there is for new Pokémon-like games. And with Pokémon Winds and Waves still around a year and a half away, I totally get it.

We’re here to answer any burning questions you have about Aniimo before you start playing.

Aniimo is available now on PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S right now, and it will launch on iOS and Android mobile devices on September 23, 2026.

Yes, Aniimo is completely free to download and play on all platforms.

Yes, Aniimo has many microtransactions, including a monthly pass and several one-time purchases that boost your items, let you skip content, and much more.

Yes, Aniimo is on Xbox Game Pass, with Game Pass subscribers getting a unique monthly reward pack of: 1x AniiPod Ultra, 15x Growth Flower, 300x Glimmer.

Yes, Aniimo is a multiplayer game, but it can be played solo. When exploring the overworld, you will be on your own most of the time, with only dedicated social spaces featuring other players.

However, you can invite friends to play together while exploring the world, or play the game’s PvEvP modes.

In the launch version of the game, there are 99 unique Aniimo, though many of them also have multiple variants that alter their elemental type, leading to over 200 Aniimo if you include all of them.

items.title: Complete Aniimo Roadmap—All September & October Events
items.summary: Aniimo has an intense roadmap ahead of it, with a ton of new limited-time events on the horizon following the game's release.
items.content:
The start of a new game is always one of the best periods to play, and the same can be said for Aniimo, the latest entry into the creature-capture genre. That said, there’s plenty more in store for the live-service title, as a hefty roadmap has been revealed.

Pawprint Studio has plenty of live events planned for Aniimo, and it’s a good thing too, as millions of players around the world have signed up and jumped into the game already.

If you’re one of the many, you won’t want to miss out on the events planned, so here’s the complete Aniimo roadmap for September and October 2026.

Pawprint has unveiled a packed Aniimo roadmap, and it details every event taking place in the game until the end of October 2026.

As things stand, full details remain unclear for each of the specific events, though they’re bound to be unveiled closer to each one’s launch. Until then, you can use the dates from the roadmap to begin planning when you’ll want to log in to the game.

That said, the roadmap can be a lot to take in at once, especially with how many events are set to take place. To help digest the information, we’ve transferred the events into a table below, which shows every announced event for Aniimo, including their start and end dates.

Whilst it hasn’t been confirmed by Pawprint Studio, there will likely be another roadmap for Aniimo detailing future events towards the end of October.

Aniimo has more than enough content to see it through the next two months, but as is always the case with live service titles, there’s bound to be more to come in the future. As for when that content is revealed, it remains unknown, but given that we know the schedule all the way until November, it’ll likely be revealed just before then.

That said, some events seem like regular occurrences, with Eggceleration and Vein Abundance amongst those that could continue to appear beyond October and the revealed calendar.

Which event are you most excited for? Share your thoughts in the official Insider Gaming Discord Server .

items.title: Aniimo Launches Worldwide on Xbox and Game Pass With 200-Plus Creatures
items.summary: Aniimo is now available worldwide on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC, and Xbox Game Pass.
items.content:
Aniimo is now available worldwide on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC, and Xbox Game Pass. Pawprint Studio’s creature-collecting game launches with more than 200 Aniimo for players to discover, meet, and collect across the world of Idyll.

That launch roster includes Squarrel and its evolution, Squashel, which are among the newest creatures added to the game.

One of the more substantial launch changes concerns Irisalis. Responding to beta feedback, the studio redesigned the Legendary Aniimo’s entire encounter flow, including its capture process, gameplay experience, and encounter ritual. This goes beyond a balance adjustment, revising how a major creature encounter unfolds from beginning to end.

Training has also been reworked for launch. The Held Item System has been simplified, Star Dust drop rates have increased, and progression caps now unlock alongside each Aniimo’s level progression. Taken together, those changes appear intended to reduce friction between collecting a creature and continuing to develop it.

Elsewhere, Pawprint Studio refined Homeland progression and upgrades while expanding its map with more features, activities, and interactive elements. Mobile and gamepad controls have been optimized, while multilingual voice acting has been added to the main story alongside improved translations.

The interesting detail here is that Irisalis is not a one-off revision. Pawprint Studio will use the redesigned encounter structure as the foundation for future Legendary Aniimo events, giving today’s launch update a direct line into the game’s next major creature encounters.

Lachlan's passion for gaming started when he played DOS games like Commander Keen and Wacky Races. His passion grew when he discovered his Aunt's Atari 2600 and was given a Game Boy for Christmas from his Pa. His favourite console has been the PlayStation 1. Right now he has become a little lazy with gaming but still enjoys the occasional FIFA session. He hopes to get back into playing games more regularly so he can switch off from the real world like he did as a Kid. He's excited about the introduction of VR and hopes for some great VR titles.

items.title: New Free-to-Play Pokémon Rival Aniimo Launches Today on PC and Consoles
items.summary: Pawprint Studio’s free-to-play RPG combines open-world creature catching, real-time combat, transformations, and multiplayer, although its beta tests produced sharply divided impressions.
items.content:
Pawprint Studio’s free-to-play RPG combines open-world creature catching, real-time combat, transformations, and multiplayer, although its beta tests produced sharply divided impressions.

Pawprint Studio is preparing to launch Aniimo , its ambitious free-to-play creature-catching RPG, following three rounds of testing that left players impressed by its beautiful world and unusual mechanics but divided over its technical polish and familiar gacha progression.

Aniimo’s servers will open in the Americas on September 15 at 7 PM PT, corresponding with its official September 16 global launch. The game will be available on PC through Steam and the Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox Cloud Gaming. Versions for iOS and Android will follow on September 23, with progress shared between platforms when players remain on the same regional server.

The game takes players to Idyll, a large open world inhabited by creatures known as Aniimo. As Pathfinders, players can capture, train, evolve, and fight alongside these creatures, but Aniimo’s defining mechanic goes considerably further than traditional monster collecting.

Yes, it's very similar to other creature collection games like Pokémon, but with a few differences and nuances as well.

For example, Twining allows a Pathfinder to temporarily become an Aniimo, gaining access to its movement abilities, senses, attacks, and environmental interactions. Different creatures can therefore change how players traverse the world, approach real-time battles, solve puzzles, and interact with other Aniimo species.

That mechanic was central to Pawprint Studio’s vision when the project was first revealed. As the developers previously explained in interviews , the team wanted creatures to feel like inhabitants of an ecosystem rather than collectible units that simply waited for a battle. Aniimo have families, behaviors, relationships, preferred environments, and reactions to other species, encouraging players to observe them in the wild.

The launch version also contains several multiplayer systems. Players can explore Idyll and battle wild Aniimo together, join other Pathfinders against powerful Alpha creatures, spend time in shared social areas, and participate in activities including Operation: Egg Heist. Each player also receives a customizable RV and Home area featuring farming, construction, decorations, interactive furniture, and resident Aniimo.

These features produced some of the most encouraging responses during Aniimo’s closed tests. Players frequently praised the colorful environments, sense of scale, creature-catching mechanics, and the ability to explore alongside other people.

Aniimo’s multiplayer may be its most meaningful competitive advantage. Many contemporary free-to-play RPGs restrict co-op to a relatively small collection of activities, but Aniimo allows players to explore, fight creatures, and participate in its world together.

The recurring criticism from pre-launch impressions is that Aniimo combines ideas from Pokémon, Genshin Impact, Palworld, and The Legend of Zelda without always establishing a sufficiently clear identity of its own.

PC Gamer’s closed-beta assessment was particularly negative, criticizing its abundance of currencies, reward screens, upgrade systems, limited-time activities, and familiar free-to-play structure. They felt that the Twining system, creature interactions, and functional multiplayer were interesting, but those qualities were buried beneath conventions borrowed from other gacha RPGs.

The developer has acknowledged both the enthusiasm for the game and the frustration from the community. In an extensive pre-launch message , Pawprint detailed numerous changes made after reviewing feedback from all three tests.

One of the largest adjustments concerns the Legendary Aniimo Irisalis. Its original encounter required players to repeatedly complete a challenge and throw multiple Aniipods while relying heavily on chance. Testers described the process as repetitive and draining, prompting Pawprint to redesign it for launch.
